verdict: Every discrepancy the round-1 verdict raised is resolved, and the round-1 fix is real work: 45 .xls/.zip documents retrieved with an INDEX that re-hashes perfectly, 28 of them newly cited, 11 superseded operator statements recorded with lineage, 41 corroborating instants attached, the reopening-day rule stated and applied, and every verbatim-fidelity slip signposted. The arithmetic in `coverage` is now exact to the row. But the round-1 fix widened the .xls channel while leaving the PDF channel exactly as round 0 left it, and that is where it breaks: `2013-4th-of-july-done.pdf` sits in BOTH rounds' own saved CDX enumerations, was retrieved by neither, and is CME's later revision of the 2013 Independence Day schedule - it moves Dairy, Lumber and Livestock out of the 'Regular Close - Per each product schedule' list into explicit early closes at 1200/1202/1215 CT on Wednesday July 3 2013. The file records that row as status 'normal'. That is a wrong final-state status, not an evidence-record nit. A second class of failure has the same shape: 42 earlier distinct-digest captures of the cited PDF URLs were never retrieved while missing[10] presents the superseded set as complete, and I verified two of them carry different session values. Separately, missing[2] declares the Good Friday 2013 '1355' zone unknown while a document already in this corpus - X13GFPD's 'Good Fri.' sheet - prints 13:55 for Dairy, Livestock and Lumber under 'Early Thur. Close' with a Notes row reading 'All times are CT'.
